mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy rational functions with independent smooth constitutive jets

inputs: Fixed cubic P+sW-V+gamma X Box chi action; minimally coupled potential dust; arbitrary smooth spherical initial normal-rest density

regular origin understood by smooth limits
